name: Grade 7 IIT Practice: July Week 5 - Operators
description: Practice words for comparison and logic operators.

words.definition: A symbol or block that compares or calculates.
words.example: The greater-than operator compared the score to the goal.

words.definition: Checking how two values are related.
words.example: The comparison checked if the timer was less than zero.
The game logic decided when the player won.
The condition was true when the sprite touched the target.

words.definition: Not correct or not matching a condition.
words.example: The condition was false when the sprite missed the target.

words.definition: What happens after an input or event.
words.example: The response played a sound after the player clicked.
